svg.title: Governance layers for adapting hybrid scoring
svg.desc: Five stacked layers show data boundaries, rule provenance, model evaluation, human decision process, and platform operations. The educational lab proves only interface behavior, not fitness for financial decisions.
svg.text: A scoring API is only one layer of a governed decision system

g.text: purpose, minimization, quality, privacy, retention, representative labels
Lab proof: synthetic-only inputs and bounded fields
documented source, owner, version, thresholds, change approval
Lab proof: visible illustrative signals and weights
quality, calibration, disparities, robustness, drift, endpoint provenance
Lab proof: bounded output, explicit live/simulator mode, failure fallback
review criteria, escalation, appeal, override, accountability
Lab boundary: no approval, blocking, or real transaction decision
isolation, secrets, monitoring, audit, capacity, rollback, incident response
Lab proof: namespace scope, runtime Secret, health and usage statistics

svg.text: Passing the lab contract is not evidence that the sample policy is accurate, fair, compliant, or production-ready.
